intro: CAVA Yogurt Dill dressing brings a refreshing Mediterranean twist to your bowl or pita with only 30 calories per serving. This creamy, tangy dressing combines Greek yogurt, fresh dill, and bright lemon for a light yet flavorful finish. Available as one of your complimentary dressing choices from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), it perfectly complements any customized creation from the [full CAVA menu](/). A lighter alternative to heavier dressings without sacrificing taste.
priceCalories: Yogurt Dill dressing is included with your order at no additional charge, as you can select up to 2 dressings per bowl or pita. At just 30 calories per serving, it is the lowest-calorie dressing option on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings). This makes it an excellent choice for health-conscious diners who want maximum flavor with minimal caloric impact. The complimentary pricing adds exceptional value to every CAVA meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Yogurt Dill apart is its authentic Mediterranean flavor profile achieved through simple, quality ingredients. The Greek yogurt base provides creamy texture and protein, while fresh dill adds herbaceous notes and lemon brings brightness. Unlike mayo-based dressings, this offers tangy refreshment without heaviness. The clean ingredient list with no artificial additives makes it a standout choice for those seeking wholesome options at CAVA.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Yogurt Dill contains 30 calories, 2g protein, 1g carbohydrates, and 2g fat. The high protein content relative to calories makes it nutritionally efficient compared to other dressings. With minimal carbs and moderate healthy fats from Greek yogurt, it fits various dietary preferences. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how it impacts your complete meal totals and explore the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary information.
whatsInside: Yogurt Dill features three simple ingredients: Greek yogurt, fresh dill, and lemon. The Greek yogurt provides a thick, creamy base rich in probiotics and protein. Fresh dill contributes distinctive herbaceous flavor with subtle anise notes. Bright lemon juice adds acidity that balances the richness while enhancing other flavors. This minimalist approach ensures clean taste without fillers, preservatives, or artificial ingredients found in many commercial dressings.
tasteLike: Yogurt Dill delivers a cool, tangy flavor with herbaceous brightness. The Greek yogurt creates a creamy, slightly tart base similar to tzatziki but lighter. Fresh dill provides distinct herbal notes that are refreshing rather than overpowering. Lemon adds citrus brightness that makes the dressing taste light and clean. The overall effect is cooling and refreshing, making it particularly appealing on grain bowls with roasted vegetables from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases).
customize: Yogurt Dill pairs beautifully with items from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Grilled Chicken or Falafel. Layer it over greens and grains, then add from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) like cucumber, tomatoes, and pickled onions. Combine with Tzatziki or Hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) for extra Mediterranean flair. Remember you can select two dressings, so consider pairing Yogurt Dill with Hot Harissa for contrasting heat.
pairsWell: Yogurt Dill complements Mediterranean proteins like Grilled Chicken, Spicy Lamb Meatballs, and Falafel exceptionally well. It balances the richness of roasted vegetables and enhances fresh toppings like cucumber, tomato, and cabbage. The cooling nature makes it ideal alongside spicier elements like Harissa or Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. It also works beautifully with grain bases, particularly the SuperGreens or Lentil options, creating refreshing flavor combinations throughout your bowl or pita.
healthyChoice: At only 30 calories with 2g of protein, Yogurt Dill ranks among the healthiest dressing choices at CAVA. The Greek yogurt provides probiotics that support digestive health, while the minimal fat content keeps it light. With just 1g of carbohydrates, it suits low-carb and keto-friendly eating patterns. The natural ingredients without added sugars or artificial components make it ideal for clean eating. Visit the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) to confirm dietary compatibility.
howToOrder: When building your bowl or pita at CAVA, proceed through base, main, and topping selections, then choose dressings. Request Yogurt Dill as one of your two complimentary dressing options. Specify whether you want it drizzled on top or served on the side for dipping. Consider ordering extra dressing if you prefer more generous portions. Explore [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) options that feature this dressing, or create your own custom combination.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories or Garlic Dressing at 180 calories, Yogurt Dill offers significantly fewer calories while providing creaminess. Unlike Lemon Herb Tahini at 70 calories, it delivers tanginess from yogurt rather than nuttiness. Hot Harissa Vinaigrette matches it at 70 calories but offers heat instead of cooling properties. Yogurt Dill provides the protein advantage with 2g per serving, making it nutritionally superior for those prioritizing protein intake.
whoShouldTry: Yogurt Dill is perfect for health-conscious diners seeking maximum flavor with minimal calories. Mediterranean food enthusiasts will appreciate its authentic flavor profile reminiscent of traditional Greek cuisine. Those following high-protein, low-carb, or calorie-restricted diets benefit from its excellent macronutrient balance. If you enjoy cooling, herbaceous flavors or need a lighter alternative to mayo-based dressings, this is your ideal choice. Anyone building a balanced bowl will find it enhances without overwhelming.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying, especially given it is included at no extra cost with your meal. Yogurt Dill delivers authentic Mediterranean flavor that elevates any bowl or pita while keeping calories remarkably low. The combination of creamy texture, herbal brightness, and tangy finish creates a versatile dressing that complements nearly every menu item. Whether you are health-focused or simply seeking delicious flavor, this dressing deserves a spot in your CAVA order.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Yogurt Dill dressing?
faqs.a: CAVA Yogurt Dill dressing contains 30 calories per serving, making it the lowest-calorie dressing option available. It provides 2g of protein, 1g of carbohydrates, and 2g of fat, offering excellent nutritional value for health-conscious diners.

faqs.q: Is Yogurt Dill dressing included with my CAVA order?
faqs.a: Yes, Yogurt Dill is included with your order at no additional charge. You can select up to 2 dressings per bowl or pita as part of your base meal price, making it an excellent value choice.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Yogurt Dill dressing taste like?
faqs.a: Yogurt Dill tastes cool, tangy, and refreshing with herbaceous notes. The Greek yogurt provides creamy tartness, fresh dill adds distinctive herbal flavor, and lemon contributes bright citrus notes for a light, Mediterranean-inspired taste.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Yogurt Dill dressing?
faqs.a: Yogurt Dill contains three simple ingredients: Greek yogurt, fresh dill, and lemon. This minimalist approach ensures authentic flavor without artificial additives, preservatives, or unnecessary fillers found in many commercial dressings.

faqs.q: Is Yogurt Dill dressing gluten-free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Yogurt Dill dressing is gluten-free, made with naturally gluten-free ingredients including Greek yogurt, fresh dill, and lemon. For complete allergen information and dietary details, consult the official CAVA allergen menu or ask staff when ordering.
